brief: June 3 has a clear spine: BrainSpace and Ax's Day dashboard work up front, a focused middle block for Notes closeout, a PandA calendar block at 5 PM, and Knicks @ Spurs at 8:30. Keep the real commitments bright; let optional public-candidate ideas sit quietly at the bottom.

periods.label: Warm-up
periods.intention: Start from proof instead of drift: check the calendar, read the overnight checkpoints, and make the first visible artifact real.

items.html: Calendar: local Calendar.app found two unique calendar moments today: a PandA block from 5:00-6:45 PM and Knicks @ Spurs from 8:30-11:00 PM.
BrainSpace Spaces: Spaces polish and edge-state capture landed locally with 14 screenshots, a canonical feature doc, a public guide, a bundled Bo KB entry, and a source-hash drift check.
Stewart: the screenshot-library protocol is now in the HQ root instructions, so visible generated work should be captured by agents, not merely remembered.

periods.label: Q1
periods.title: Feature Truth
periods.intention: Convert the morning's product walkthroughs into shippable, documented feature truth before messages fragment attention.

items.html: BrainSpace Tasks: Tasks completed the full walkthrough: recurrence, Reminders push hooks, per-space create, reusable TaskRow, screenshots, canonical doc, public guide, Bo KB, and sync check.
BrainSpace Notes: Notes moved through audit, fixes, and design pass: Planner pin/delete, reusable NoteRow, auto-title, raw/preview markdown toggle, slash insert, and 4 screenshots.
Ax's Day: the Today tab became a real quarter-based dashboard with a briefing paragraph, six expandable phase cards, black active state, compact past cards, and source footnotes.

periods.label: Q2
periods.title: Docs Closeout
periods.intention: Close the docs gap before opening the next BrainSpace bucket.
periods.reset: At 3 PM, take halftime seriously: step away, then choose Notes closeout or Calendar and Events start.

items.html: Finish Notes: write docs/features/notes.md, derive the public guide and Bo KB, then run the feature sync check.
Capture evidence: confirm the Notes screenshot index and add any final Today-dashboard screenshots to the June 3 screenshot library.
Repo posture: decide whether BrainSpace local commits should be pushed today or intentionally parked with a clean handoff.

periods.label: Q3
periods.title: Second-Half Decision
periods.intention: Turn the morning's progress into a clean second-half decision.
periods.reset: Halftime question: what is still worth winning today, and what should be parked so it does not become mental residue?

items.html: If Notes is green: start the Calendar and Events walkthrough using the same audit, screenshots, docs, guide, and Bo KB pipeline.
If Notes is not green: keep Q3 focused on finishing Notes instead of opening another feature surface.
Device-only backlog: keep Bo runtime KB answers, task recurrence, Reminders mirror, and two-way iCloud notes tracked as verification items.

periods.label: Q4
periods.title: Evening Lane
periods.intention: Choose a low-friction evening lane before the calendar takes over.

items.html: Calendar: keep 5:00-6:45 PM protected for the PandA block, then Knicks @ Spurs is on from 8:30-11:00 PM.
Public-candidate shelf: if there is spare energy, revisit docs as product design, reusable component rows, no-title notes, or the quarter-based AI workday dashboard.

periods.label: Cool down
periods.intention: Land the receipts so tomorrow can resume without archaeology.

items.html: Receipts: keep the final Today preview capture and any BrainSpace evidence in the June 3 screenshot library.
Tomorrow setup: leave one plain-English handoff for the next agent if there are open dashboard or BrainSpace decisions.
Next work order: Notes docs first, Calendar and Events second, Today payload ingestion third.

sources.label: Calendar
sources.text: Trusted source for this pass is local Calendar.app. It returned a PandA block from 5:00-6:45 PM and Knicks @ Spurs from 8:30-11:00 PM; duplicate Knicks sports calendars were collapsed.

sources.label: Connector caveat
sources.text: Google Calendar `primary` and `ax@studio89.design` searches returned no events, so the Google connector is not currently reliable for Ax's visible/delegated calendar set.

sources.label: HQ checkpoints
sources.text: Read 08:17 BrainSpace Spaces, 09:40 BrainSpace Tasks, 10:34 BrainSpace Notes, and the Ax's Day dashboard artifact bundle.
